note: App content (assembly specification of the payment and statement apps, 22). The core never reads it (18, 4.5). Core names are those of specs 02, 03, 07 and 09. Statuses: MAPPED a core column or master data field. DERIVED computed from core data, a core read or the app run. CONSTANT a fixed value. APP data that lives in the app by design (22). EXTENSION an extension attribute owned by the app (22, 5.7). GAP needed by the message or profile and not held by the core. OMITTED not produced. Basis: EPC the dictionary of the EPC guideline (primary source for SEPA credit transfer), BANK a bank format guide (secondary, a subset of the ISO message), KNOWLEDGE authored from general knowledge with no source read (UNVERIFIED, weakest)
